web-guide-idea-22.audience: Listeners who already enjoy your original music.
web-guide-idea-22.offer: Offer a small live concert with introductions, works in progress and a prepared set. People are buying an intentional performance and connection with the musician.
web-guide-idea-22.steps.0: Choose original or cleared songs and rehearse transitions.
web-guide-idea-22.steps.1: Perform a focused set with brief stories between songs.
web-guide-idea-22.steps.2: Answer a few questions and preview a new piece.
web-guide-idea-22.equipment: A phone, quiet room and your instrument if used. Test sound levels; an external microphone is an optional upgrade.
web-guide-idea-22.returnReason: Make each concert a new chapter: new songs, acoustic arrangements or a writing theme.
web-guide-idea-22.promotion: Share a short original performance sample and the concert’s theme and length.
